flow.si_to_vo.title: Site instruction to variation order
flow.si_to_vo.intro1: SI-114 came in on 2026-08-19: rock excavation to the lift pit, grids C4 to D5.
flow.si_to_vo.intro2: Nothing priced against it. Four minutes to get the notice out before the clock bites.
flow.si_to_vo.started.body: First thing: has any of this work actually started on site?
flow.si_to_vo.started.afterStarted: The 20 working days ran from the instruction. You have {wd} working days left on the notice. Keep going.
flow.si_to_vo.started.afterNot: Good. Inside the window either way. Notice before you start is the cleanest position.
flow.si_to_vo.price.body: Actual cost — labour, plant and material. Not a bill rate.
flow.si_to_vo.time.body: Did the rock cost you time on the critical path, not just money?
flow.si_to_vo.checks.body: Last gate. Submit only exists when all four are true.
flow.si_to_vo.checks.actual: Priced on actual cost, not bill rates
flow.si_to_vo.checks.written: Instruction in writing from the principal agent
